definition: The flat drawing of this view laid over the model at the same scale, so the two can be checked against each other. It is offered only at a view a plate is drawn for, and never over a perspective, which has no single scale.
basis: Our wording of the plate over the model. docs/scene.md: "The flat plate is laid over the model by" the frame each renderer writes, and a perspective takes none, because "The overlay's whole argument is a uniform scale".
